description: Juro contract read integration. Actions: list_contracts (GET /v3/contracts, paginated with skip and limit, filterable by teamIds and templateId and by updatedSince and updatedBefore for incremental reads), get_contract (GET /v3/contracts/{id}), list_templates (GET /v3/templates), get_template (GET /v3/templates/{id}). Juro calls these records contracts; finance and legal workflows often call them agreements. Read-only: the tool drafts, edits, sends, and signs nothing. Authenticates against api.juro.com with a workspace API key injected by the host as the x-api-key header.

static_token.instructions: Retrieve your API key in Juro under Settings > Integrations > API & webhooks. The key is sent as the x-api-key header.

auth.instructions:
1. In Juro, go to Settings > Integrations > API & webhooks and create or copy your API key.
2. Store it on the IronClaw host:

   ```sh
   export JURO_API_KEY=<api key>
   ```

3. Run `ironclaw tool install juro` to register the tool.
4. The key scopes to one Juro workspace and inherits that key's permissions, so contracts outside its teams are not visible.
